data.narrative:
Integrate is a Series A-stage defense & security company that has raised $21M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comparable universe of 10 same-sector peers at Series A and Series B stages, comprising 2 public names (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private companies including Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, and NODA AI.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis uses the $21M total raised as a valuation proxy and applies a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical for Series A advancement, implying a $42M valuation. Peer-median analysis examines the 10-company comparable set, which displays a median valuation of $1.0B with a range of $125M to $3.0B. The peer median is anchored by Series B names including Dream Security at $3.0B, Harmattan AI at $1.4B, Code Metal at $1.2B, and Castelion and Defense Unicorns at $1.0B each.

The two methods produce a wide triangulated range: $36M (low), $521M (median), and $1.1B (high). The 30x spread between low and high reflects meaningful uncertainty around Integrate's competitive positioning and near-term growth trajectory relative to the peer cohort. Stage-progression anchors a floor; peer medians suggest substantially higher valuation if Integrate is tracking comparable companies' progress. Key uncertainties include customer traction, proprietary differentiation, and capital efficiency relative to sampled peers.
